args:
# --- the cube this stream reads ---------------------------------------
let cube = "zp3803rs"
let area_dim = "nuts14"
let period_dim = "zp3803rs_rok"
let indicator_dim = "zp3803rs_ukaz"
let key_dims = ["zp3803rs_dim1"]
let unit_code = "TNE"
let unit_text = "v tonách na km2"
# A cell times this is in the unit unitCode names: 1000 for a cube stated in thousands
# ("v tis. m3"), else 1 (F-BNT1-015).
let scale = 1
let source_url = "https://data.statistics.sk/api/v2/dataset/zp3803rs/SK032,SK0321,SK0322,SK0323,SK0324,SK0325,SK0326,SK0327,SK0328,SK0329,SK032A,SK032B,SK032C,SK032D/*/ODPAD_TONY_KM2/1?lang=sk&type=json"
let domain = "bbsk.sk"
# JSON-stat 2.0, decoded by the index and never by the order. `value` is flat and
# row-major over `size`; the position of a code inside a dimension is
# `dimension.{name}.category.index`, which is NOT sorted: the period dimension comes back
# newest first (`["2024", "2023"]`). Reading it as ascending puts every figure against the
# wrong year, and the number is real, so nothing about it looks wrong (T-2304 correction).
let ds = this
let ids = this.id
let sizes = this.size
let n = $sizes.length()
let codes = $ids.map_each(d -> $ds.dimension.get(d).category.index.key_values().sort_by(kv -> kv.value).map_each(kv -> kv.key))
let strides = range(0, $n, 1).map_each(k -> if k + 1 >= $n { 1 } else { $sizes.slice(k + 1, $n).fold(1, t -> t.tally * t.value) })
# The publisher's own "last updated", which is what a cell was observed at. A cube with none
# yields null and the entity carries no dateObserved rather than an invented one.
let updated = $ds.update.or("").ts_parse("2006-01-02").ts_format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00", "UTC").catch(null)
# One entity per cell that carries a number. A cell the publisher left empty is not a zero.
root = range(0, $ds.value.length(), 1).map_each(p -> { "at": range(0, $n, 1).map_each(k -> { $ids.index(k): $codes.index(k).index(((p / $strides.index(k)).floor().int64()) % $sizes.index(k)) }).squash(), "cell": $ds.value.index(p) }).filter(c -> c.cell != null).map_each(c -> {
  "id": "urn:ngsi-ld:%v:%v:%v:%v".format("KeyPerformanceIndicator", $domain, env("JC_SPACE"), [$cube, c.at.get($area_dim), c.at.get($period_dim), c.at.get($indicator_dim)].concat($key_dims.map_each(d -> c.at.get(d))).join("-")),
  "type": "KeyPerformanceIndicator",
  "dataSet": { "type": "Property", "value": $cube },
  "indicator": { "type": "Property", "value": c.at.get($indicator_dim) },
  "refArea": { "type": "Property", "value": c.at.get($area_dim) },
  "refPeriod": { "type": "Property", "value": c.at.get($period_dim) },
  "dimensionKey": if $key_dims.length() == 0 { null } else { { "type": "Property", "value": $key_dims.map_each(d -> c.at.get(d)).join("-") } },
  # `observedAt` belongs to the attribute, never to the entity: CIM 009 4.5.1 makes it a
  # core non-reified term, and the broker refuses a whole entity that carries one as an
  # attribute of its own — 400 per entity, dropped by `drop_on`, so the space stayed empty
  # in silence (T-2445). A cube that states no update time gets no `observedAt` at all.
  # A unit with no UN/CEFACT code (a currency) and a cube with no update time leave their
  # term out rather than write a null the broker refuses.
  "kpiValue": { "type": "Property", "value": c.cell * $scale, "unitCode": $unit_code, "observedAt": $updated }.filter(entry -> entry.value != null),
  "unitText": { "type": "Property", "value": $unit_text },
  "source": { "type": "Property", "value": $source_url },
  "dateObserved": if $updated == null { null } else { { "type": "Property", "value": $updated } }
}.filter(entry -> entry.value != null))
